gloss: and; or; such things as; I hear

definitions.gloss: and; or; such things as (casual listing)
definitions.explanation: Lists one or more examples out of a larger set, in casual speech.

definitions.gloss: I hear; something like (hearsay, vague quotation)
definitions.explanation: After a clause or a quotation, marks what was said or heard as uncertain or only roughly quoted.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧とかみかんとか⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like things like apples and mandarin oranges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧とか⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧とか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On weekends I go to movies, go shopping, that kind of thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧とか⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧とか、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{見|み}たい→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When I go to Japan, I want to see lots of old buildings, temples and shrines and so on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とか。
examples.english: I hear Tanaka is getting married next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧とか⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: The manager said something about taking today off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧とか⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently school's off tomorrow because of a typhoon or something.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- AとかBとか: A and B and so on (the last item usually takes とか too)
- Nとか + suggestion: softens it — ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧とか⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧？ (how about some tea or something?)
- 〜とか⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ / 〜とか⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: someone said / I heard something like ~
- 〜とか⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: because of ~, so I hear

REGISTER:
Casual. In writing and formal speech, list with や or ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧ instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- や: neutral listing of examples; not repeated after the last item
- ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧: "and so on", closes a list; more formal
- たり: lists example actions (〜たり〜たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧), where とか lists nouns or clauses
